theme_identity.name: JEELIVE.AI Deep Blood Dark Theme
theme_identity.description: Official JEELIVE.AI visual identity matching the public live site. Deep dark surface (#08080A), high-contrast blood red accents (#D91222 / #FF6974), dark maroon soft badges (#280D13), and refined card surfaces (#14141C / #0F0F14).

pyq_minimal_click_flow.entry_point: JEE Main Hub card -> Direct click to PYQ papers list
pyq_minimal_click_flow.paper_list_header: Header with title 'JEE Main PYQs' and inline Year filter chips (All, 2026, 2025, 2024, 2023) and Shift filter chips (All, Jan Shift 1, Jan Shift 2, Apr Shift 1, Apr Shift 2)

row_card_structure.left: Icon / Year badge in #280D13 container with #FF6974 text
row_card_structure.middle: Paper Title (e.g., JEE Main 2026 24 Jan Shift 1), metadata count (75 Q, 180 min, 300 marks)

actions.in_progress: Single 'Continue' button (#F1BC63 amber background, dark text)
actions.completed: Two distinct buttons: 'Result' (#280D13 border button) and 'Re-attempt' (#D91222 background button)

pyq_minimal_click_flow.empty_and_error_states: Honest status display if backend returns 0 published papers: 'No PYQ papers live yet' with clear message and retry action.

components.ExamTile: Card with 136px height image banner, rounded 24px container, deep dark background #14141C
components.ExamHub: JEE Main replaced Mock entry with direct 'PYQ papers' option (Explore PYQ papers / Start PYQ)
components.SeriesBanner: Flagship 100% AI banner in deep blood maroon (#160B10) with radiant glow and 200+ tagline
components.SetRow: Minimal-click paper row with dynamic Start / Continue / Result + Re-attempt action triggers
components.SolutionNavigator: Horizontal scrollable question pill bar with green (correct), red (incorrect), yellow (skipped) states and uploaded solution viewer

instructions_to_main_agent: Update frontend theme tokens in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to match jeelive.ai public live site colors exactly (#08080A background, #D91222 primary, #FF6974 brandText, #280D13 brandSoft, #67202C brandLine).
Ensure JEE Main hub route replaces Mock tests entry with PYQ papers entry.
Implement the minimal-click PYQ flow: directly displaying paper list with inline Year and Shift filters.
Provide immediate action buttons on paper rows: 'Start' for unattempted, 'Continue' for in-progress, and twin buttons 'Result' & 'Re-attempt' for completed tests.
Handle empty states gracefully when zero published PYQ papers are returned from API, showing an honest status without fabricated data.
Preserve all existing functionality for BITSAT, COMEDK, Chapter practice, Live series, and Rapid Fire.
Include data-testid on all interactive PYQ elements for test automation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark gradients over dark backgrounds — use solid deep dark #08080A background with crisp 1px #2A2A38 / #67202C borders.
Always set explicit text color on hover and active states.
Keep layout spacing clean and responsive with 2x padding.
All interactive components MUST contain kebab-case data-testid attributes.
